statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The diagnoses are paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The service was to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The extended monitoring will assist in confirming the diagnosis and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
